candidate.background_need: Twelve fictional self-employed artists in the Northlight district lack verified practical skills in pricing and customer development. They have access to a shared workshop for a six-month pilot period.

objectives.description: Enable participants to test one realistic service offer with simulated customers.
Enhance participants' ability to explain costs and value of their services.

target_groups: Twelve fictional self-employed artists in the Northlight district, Finland

preliminary_activities.description: Define a single realistic service offer for testing within the workshop environment.
Conduct simulated market interactions using defined 'fictional customers' over six months.
Facilitate structured sessions on cost calculation and value articulation techniques.
Review service offers and feedback with the Fictional Northlight Arts Association partner.

expected_results.description: Participants complete a tested service offer cycle.
Participants demonstrate ability to articulate costs and value.
Artists gain confidence in applying service concepts to their practice.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of distinct service offers tested by participants.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Count of unique service proposals submitted during the pilot period (6 months). Unit: count. Denominator: 12 artists.

proposed_indicators.description: Percentage of participants able to verbally explain cost and value components.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Assessment score based on structured observation checklist during simulated client meetings (6 months). Unit: percentage. Denominator: 12 artists.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of participants reporting increased confidence in service application.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Self-reported survey response indicating 'high' or 'very high' confidence level (6 months). Unit: count. Denominator: 12 artists.

assumptions: The six-month workshop period is fully available and managed by the Fictional Northlight Arts Association.
'Fictional customers' will be defined and utilized consistently to simulate market dynamics.
No external funding eligibility has been verified prior to activity start.
open_questions: Confirmation of specific funding source and eligibility rules.
Definition of the precise service offer structure for testing.
Clarification on whether 'fictional customers' constitute a simulation tool or placeholder for real engagement.
